title: Schwarz Modulus Based Matrix Splittings with Minimal Polynomial Extrapolation Acceleration for linear complementarity problems arising from American option pricing
summary: Pricing American options is more complicated than pricing European options, because they can be exercised at any time, and one thus needs to solve a linear complementarity problem instead of simply doing time stepping for computing European options. We introduce a new Schwarz modulus-based splitting method for solving such linear complementarity problems, and further accelerate them using Modified Polynomial Extrapolation, a non-linear vector sequence acceleration technique, which is very much related to Krylov methods in the linear case.
